executive_summary:
Episode 35 centers on a read-aloud anonymous insider email that alleges the Egyptian military aircraft tail number SUBTT made repeated, multi-day stops in Wilmington, Delaware because of federal activity at 920 North King Street, a building the email identifies as housing the FBI, DEA, and Secret Service. The host anchors the email's premises to a series of displayed/linked artifacts: the host's compiled flight-pattern chart for SUBTT, a 1997 DOJ directory reference, a December 2024 SATIDS (French aircraft finishing company) announcement regarding the Wilmington hangar, a DRBA January 2024 resolution, and an FBI December 5, 2024 press release. She claims to have vetted the tip with contacts at federal agencies and the State Department.

The second evidentiary strand introduces a documentary contradiction within TPUSA's own post-event statements: Frank Turk's Megan Kelly interview (A-1441) describing Charlie's team operating drones is presented against Brian Harpole's Shawn Ryan interview (A-1442) stating no drones were used. The episode also documents Harpole's repetition of the "3,000 lbs of energy" bullet-trajectory claim and includes read/played clips of Joe Rogan / Theo Von discussing conspiracies and Tim Pool regarding his exclusion from AmFest.

Structurally, the episode introduces Wilmington, Delaware as a new investigative geography and elevates the insider-email-vetting process as a methodological development in the series.

claims.label: SUBTT Departed Provo 7:14 AM and Arrived Wilmington 11:51 AM ET on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: The yellow Egyptian government jet (tail number SUBTT) departed Provo, Utah at 7:14 AM local on September 10, 2025 and arrived Wilmington, Delaware at 11:51 AM Eastern.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference host's timeline against independent ADS-B / FlightAware historical data for September 10, 2025.

claims.label: SUBTT Stayed Overnight in Wilmington Until September 11 at 7:56 AM
claims.claim: The Egyptian plane remained in Wilmington, Delaware overnight and departed September 11, 2025 at 7:56 AM, ruling out a fuel-stop explanation.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify overnight ground time via independent flight tracking and Wilmington airport records.

claims.label: SUBTT Made Multi-Day Wilmington Stays in November 2022
claims.claim: SUBTT flew Cairo–Paris–Wichita–Wilmington–Cairo on November 13, 2022, then returned to Wilmington on November 17, 2022 and remained until November 20, 2022 before returning to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against independent historical ADS-B / FAA records for tail number SUBTT in November 2022.

claims.label: June 1997 DOJ Directory Lists Wilmington Resident Office at 920 King Street, Suite 404
claims.claim: A June 1997 Department of Justice directory (page titled 675) lists a Wilmington Resident Office at 1 Rodney Square, Suite 404, 920 King Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the cited DOJ directory and confirm page 675 directly; compare against current DOJ directory listings.

claims.label: 920 North King Street Currently Houses DEA, FBI, and Secret Service
claims.claim: Current public directories show DEA, FBI, and U.S. Secret Service all listed at 920 North King Street, Suite 404, Wilmington, Delaware, with phone numbers published.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via direct lookups of each agency's published Wilmington field office directory entries; cross-check Google business listings.

claims.label: SATIDS Announced in December 2024 Takeover of Wilmington Airport Hangar
claims.claim: A French aircraft finishing company, SATIDS, announced in December 2024 it was taking over the shuttered Wilmington airport hangar (formerly a Dassault Falcon authorized center), investing approximately $1M+.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate SATIDS press release and Delaware outlet coverage; confirm date and dollar figure.

claims.label: DRBA January 2024 Resolution Authorized Paint Hanger Lease to SATIDS
claims.claim: A Delaware River and Bay Authority (DRBA) January 2024 resolution authorized acquiring rights to a paint hanger formerly part of a Dassault leasehold and executing a lease with SATIDS.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the DRBA resolution document directly from DRBA public records.

claims.label: FBI Director Wray Cited Partnerships in Wilmington December 2024 Press Release
claims.claim: An FBI press release dated December 5, 2024 includes Director Christopher Wray emphasizing "key partners" and describing partnerships as closer than 5 or 10 years prior.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and review the FBI press release directly; verify quoted phrases and date.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Megan Kelly / Frank Turk interview clip and timestamp; confirm exact wording.
